card.name: Words before a governing body or agency
card.fires_on: Small linking words or word parts just before an expected government body, agency or authority is named, such as 'passed by', 'set up by', 'within this' or 'Jur-isdiction'. Also appears after phrases in technical and web text like 'may' in a bus bridge description.

modes.label: Passive verbs before an institution
modes.description: 'by' or 'the' after 'passed' or 'set up', where the government body or agent comes next.
modes.example: In 1968 Bill 90 was passed<< by>> the Union Nationale government of Premier Jean

modes.label: Government and legal terms
modes.description: Part of a word or a link word in political or administrative history, before a department or union.
modes.example: Jur<<isdiction>> was later moved to the Department of Labor

modes.label: Technical patent text
modes.description: 'may' or a number in hardware descriptions of buses and bridges.
modes.example: Memory controller/cache 208 and I/O bus bridge 210<< may>> be integrated as depicted.

card.writes: It holds back words like responsibility, authority and 负责, so the model does not predict them next.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a government body or agency is named, and it makes words like 'authority' less likely.
